site.name: M/V HONDIUS
site.desc: WHO confirmed 11 total hantavirus cases (8 confirmed, 2 probable, 1 inconclusive) as of 13 May (WHO DON601); three deaths total. Vessel evacuated at Granadilla de Abona with 87 passengers and 35 crew; en route Rotterdam with skeleton crew of 30 + Dutch nurse for full disinfection; Arctic schedule uncertain pending health authority clearance.

descChanges.prevDesc: WHO confirmed 10 global hantavirus cases linked to Hondius as of 15 May (Al Jazeera); crew remain symptom-free. Vessel evacuated at Granadilla de Abona with 87 passengers and 35 crew; en route Rotterdam with skeleton crew of 30 + Dutch nurse for full disinfection; Arctic schedule uncertain pending health authority clearance per AP 14 May.

site.name: NEBRASKA
site.desc: 18 American passengers coordinated to Offutt AFB and transferred to National Quarantine Center at UNMC per AP 13 May; 15 quarantined at NQU including content creator Jake Rosmarin (asymptomatic, 42-day quarantine). One symptomatic individual in UNMC biocontainment; Dr. Stephen Kornfeld cleared and released 14 May after inconclusive swabs resolved negative per AP 14 May. CDC actively monitoring and supporting repatriation efforts per CDC Newsroom 08 May.
